title: Q & R: Speaking Tour in England?

body:
Here’s the Q:

 I hope you don’t mind me emailing you. I guess it’s a bit late if you’re reading this!! I’m a priest in the church of England. I have three rural parishes. I want to thank you sincerely for your ministry of word and hope. Your books have helped me in my ministry. They are accessible yet deep. They are honest and yet filled with joy and happiness. Thank you and may you never lose the power you have in portraying the complex spiritual landscape of our time. Finally I would ask you to pray for me when you get a moment and will you be doing a speaking tour in England in the near future? Thanks again and may God continue to bless you and your loved ones.

 Here’s the R:

Yes! I’ll be there October 7 – 17 and I hope to meet you. Here are the details:

 http://www.pcnbritain.org.uk/news/post/tickets_for_brian_mclaren_tour_go_on_sale

You’re in my prayers today, and I hope many who read this will join me in praying for you and your ministry. God bless you!
